report.explanation: Current telemetry does not substantiate the operator's deployment hypothesis. Traces show all sampled checkout flows returning 200 with healthy inventory, payment, and postgres spans. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200s with zero 502s; v2.0.0 shows no traffic. The only deployment record is baseline v1.0.0 with no previous version, so no faulty deployment is evidenced. No bounded cause is established; hand off.
missing_evidence: Order service logs (excluded) to confirm or rule out checkout error occurrences
